prompt: The lost-profits count in the Meridian v. Corvess matter needs its total claim amount recorded. Query the document index and locate the final executed stipulated damages schedule for the case (ignore any superseded drafts). Read it in full. Compute the total stipulated claim on the lost-profits count: the stipulated lost profits plus simple prejudgment interest at the rate and for the accrual period stated in the schedule. Round to whole dollars. Then record the result on the case's amount history using litigation_cases_amount_history_create for litigation_cases_001, with claimed_amount set to the computed total and changed_by_role set to exactly damages_analyst. Do not record the principal alone; the recorded figure must include the interest.
goal: Compute lost profits + 6% simple interest over 30 months and record the total claim.
